app.name: Pawprint
app.disclaimer: Unofficial tool. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
projects.title: Projects
projects.empty.title: No blueprints yet
projects.empty.body: Open a .pawprint file to view it in 3D. Add a block pack first so blocks show with their real textures.
packs.title: Block packs
packs.intro: A block pack holds the block list, names, shapes and textures. Packs you make from your own game are stored in this browser only and are never uploaded.
packs.empty.title: No block packs yet
packs.empty.body: You can still edit without one: blocks then show as plain colored boxes.
packs.add.title: Add a pack
packs.add.openHelp: From the mod: in game press B → Library → "Export block pack". Modded blocks and your resource packs come along.
packs.add.jarHelp: Vanilla blocks only, English names. Pick .minecraft/versions/<version>/<version>.jar.
packs.partialProperties: Block properties were guessed from the jar; some may be missing.
packs.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? Blueprints keep their blocks, but they will show as plain boxes until you add a pack again.
packs.confirmReplace: "{name}" is already here. Replace it with this file?
projects.drop: Drop a .pawprint file here to open it
editor.noPack: No block pack: blocks show as plain boxes. Add one under Block packs.
editor.missing: {count} kinds of blocks are not in the pack (checkered boxes)
editor.help: Right-drag look · Right + WASD move · Q/E down/up · Wheel forward/back · Right + wheel speed · Middle-drag pan · F fit
projects.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? This cannot be undone. Download it first if you want to keep a copy.
editor.notFound: This project is not in this browser.
editor.loadFailed: The project could not be opened.
editor.saveFailed: Saving failed. Your changes are still here; try again or download the file.
editor.name: Blueprint name
editor.fillHelp: Fills the connected area of the same block on this layer.
editor.pickerHelp: Click a block to paint with it (Alt+click with any tool).
editor.fillTooLarge: That area is too large to fill. Close it in first.
editor.help2d: Left click paint · Wheel zoom · Right or middle drag pan · Alt+click pick · PgUp/PgDn layer
editor.noPackPalette: Without a block pack there is no block list. Type a block ID to paint with it.
editor.solidHelp: Drag the footprint; it grows away from the face you start on (in 2D: upward through the layers).
editor.selectHelp: Drag across blocks (3D: from one corner block to the other). Delete clears, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X copy.
editor.stampHelp: Click to place · R turn · X / Z mirror · Esc stop
editor.noClip: Nothing to stamp yet: copy a selection (Ctrl+C) or pick one from Stamps.
editor.stampsHelp: Any blueprint can be a stamp. Saved stamps (★) come first.
layers.title: Layers
layers.add: New layer above the selected one
layers.mergeDown: Move this layer's blocks into the layer below it
layers.delete: Delete the layer and its blocks
layers.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" and every block on it? Undo (Ctrl+Z) brings the blocks back.
layers.renameHint: Click to draw on this layer · double-click to rename
layers.help: New blocks go to the highlighted layer. Painting over another layer's block moves it here. Drag rows to reorder or into groups. Hidden and locked layers cannot be changed.
materials.title: Materials
window.title: Window
layout.title: Layout
layout.importFailed: That is not a Pawprint layout file.
error.title: Could not add that file
error.zip.unreadable: This is not a zip file, or it is damaged.
error.zip.tooManyEntries: The file has too many entries (over {max}).
error.zip.entryTooLarge: "{name}" inside the file is too large.
error.zip.tooLarge: The file is too large once unpacked.
error.pack.missingEntry: This is not a block pack: "{name}" is missing.
error.pack.badField: The pack is damaged: "{field}" is invalid.
error.pack.tooNew: This pack uses format {format}, which is newer than this version of Pawprint. Reload the page to update.
error.pack.tooManyBlocks: The pack lists too many blocks (over {max}).
error.pack.badBlock: The pack is damaged: block #{index} is invalid.
error.pack.noLanguage: The pack has no block names (lang folder is empty).
error.jar.notMinecraft: This does not look like a Minecraft client jar.
error.nbt.truncated: The block data ends too early (file is damaged).
error.nbt.tooLarge: The block data is too large.
error.nbt.tooDeep: The block data is nested too deeply.
error.pawprint.missingEntry: This is not a blueprint: "{name}" is missing.
error.pawprint.tooNew: This blueprint uses format {format}, which is newer than this version of Pawprint. Reload the page to update.
error.pawprint.tooLarge: The blueprint is too large to open.
error.pawprint.badData: The blueprint's block data is damaged.
